title: Pressing a key doesn't send a letter

captions.text: Pressing a key doesn't send a !letter.!
Under your keys is a *grid of wires:*
A small chip scans it *hundreds of times a second,*
Press *A,* and its row and column *connect.*
captions.say: Press ay, and its row and column connect.

captions.text: Your operating system turns that number into a *letter*

captions.say: That's why switching to azerty moves letters
